# KOMPAS Online

> Unofficial alternative frontend and JSON API for kompas.id, the Indonesian daily Kompas. It serves the latest, most popular and trending stories, keyword and date search, a daily archive, full article text and RSS feeds. Articles are in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia). Content belongs to PT Kompas Media Nusantara.

All endpoints are plain HTTP GET with no authentication. Responses are cached for about two minutes. Dates are in Jakarta time (WIB, UTC+7). Timestamps in JSON are Unix epoch seconds (UTC).

## Reading the site (HTML)

- [Front page]({BASE}/): Latest headlines, a tabbed topics box, a ranking of popular stories, news from the reader's province, topic sections, a weather box and a news calendar.
- [Feed views]({BASE}/?feed=popular): `?feed=latest|popular|hot` switches the main list.
- [Search]({BASE}/?q=banjir): `?q=<keyword>` searches all stories since 2017.
- [Daily archive]({BASE}/?date=2026-01-01): `?date=YYYY-MM-DD` lists stories published that day. The calendar widget links here.
- [Regional news]({BASE}/?q=Jawa%20Timur): Searching for a province name gives that province's news.
- Article page: `{BASE}/read?permalink=<kompas.id article URL>&format=html` is the readable story with images.
- [Random story]({BASE}/random): Redirects to a random article from the latest feed.

## JSON API

- [Article list]({BASE}/api/article): `GET /api/article` returns an array of articles.
  - `type=popular` or `type=hot` picks a feed. Leave it out for the latest stories.
  - `search=<keyword>` runs a full-text search. It is ignored when `type` is set.
  - `date=YYYY-MM-DD` gives one day's archive. It can be used with or without `search`.
  - `from=YYYY-MM-DD` and `to=YYYY-MM-DD` limit a search to a date range.
  - `page=N` gets more search results. There are 10 per page.
  - Each article has `title`, `url` (the kompas.id permalink), `content` (an array of excerpt paragraphs, which may contain inline HTML), `authors` (an array like `[{"writer": "..."}, {"editor": "..."}]`), `published_date` (epoch seconds), `keywords` (an array of strings) and `thumbnail` (an image URL or null).
- [Article detail]({BASE}/read?permalink=https://www.kompas.id/artikel/contoh): `GET /read?permalink=<url>` returns the full article as JSON. `permalink` takes a full kompas.id URL or just the slug. The response has `title`, `url`, `authors` (an array of `{role: name}`), `published_date`, `keywords`, `thumbnail` and `content`. `content` is an array of blocks, each with a `type`: `text`, `heading-2`, `heading-3`, `heading-4`, `blockquote`, `caption`, `image` (with `url`, `caption`), `ordered` (with `list`), `recommender` (with `recommendation: {title, url}`) or `separator`. A story that isn't found returns `[]`.
- [Provinces]({BASE}/api/regions): `GET /api/regions` returns `{"default": "JK", "provinces": [...]}`. Each province has its ISO 3166-2:ID `code`, Indonesian `name`, `capital`, `lat`/`lon` and English `aliases`. Search for a province `name` to get regional news.
- [Health check]({BASE}/healthz): Returns `{"status": "ok"}`.
- [OpenAPI schema]({BASE}/openapi.json): A machine-readable description of every endpoint. Interactive docs are at [/docs]({BASE}/docs).

## RSS feeds

- [Latest news]({BASE}/rss.xml)
- [Most popular]({BASE}/rss.xml?feed=popular)
- [Hot topics]({BASE}/rss.xml?feed=hot)
- Any search or day can be a feed: `{BASE}/rss.xml?q=<keyword>` or `{BASE}/rss.xml?date=YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Tips for agents

- To answer "what's the news today", call `/api/article`. Then call `/read?permalink=<url>` for the stories you need in full.
- To find news about a place, search its Indonesian name, for example `Jawa Timur`, not `East Java`. Province codes: {PROVINCES}.
- Keywords should be in Indonesian: `banjir` (flood), `pemilu` (election), `ekonomi`, `olahraga` (sport), `politik`.
- Link to the original story with the article's `url`. Link to the readable copy here with `{BASE}/read?permalink=<url>&format=html`.
